text: A股三大指数尾盘集体翻绿，贵金属、教育、光伏设备、房地产等板块跌幅居前，沪深京三市下跌个股超4300只。
text_en: A-share three major indices turned green collectively in late trading, with precious metals, education, photovoltaic equipment, and real estate sectors leading declines, and over 4,300 stocks falling across Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing markets.
